title: Use OptiSweep/WCS API Tote endpoints to initialize, exchange, and exchange-lane totes (Exchange sorter side zone)
summary: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API (via Apidog / WCS API client) tote endpoints to initialize a tote, trigger tote exchange actions (including Exchange sorter side zone requirements: sorter side name + zone), exchange to a specific lane destination, and verify results using GetToteTask and GetExchangeSettings. If needed, update exchange settings with UpdateExchange.
when_to_use: When you need to add/initialize totes and trigger tote exchange actions for testing using OptiSweep/WCS API tote endpoints, including Exchange sorter side zone usage (sorter side name + zone).
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute OptiSweep/WCS API tote endpoint calls (InitializeTote, ExchangeTote, ExchangeLane, GetToteTask, GetExchangeSettings, UpdateExchange) and validate returned API responses/active state changes.
access_or_tools_needed: Apidog / WCS API client (OptiSweep / WCS API)

system_preconditions: Exchange sorter side zone usage requires a sorter side name and a zone.

visual_references.description: Frame showing tote API endpoints and required identifiers for Exchange sorter side zone, InitializeTote (ToteID + StationID), ExchangeTote (ToteName), ExchangeLane (LaneName), GetToteTask (active state), GetExchangeSettings (current exchange headings/settings), and UpdateExchange (adjust exchange settings).
